title: My profile
emailHint: Your email address can't be changed.

danger.title: Close account
danger.body: Once you close your account, you can't sign in with it again.

deactivate.title: Do you want to close your account?
deactivate.point1: You won't be able to sign in with this account again.
deactivate.point2: Your pets' records won't be deleted.
deactivate.point3: Permissions you gave to clinics are not revoked when the account is closed; they stay valid until they expire.
deactivate.confirm: I understand my account will be closed and that this can't be undone here.

flash.accountClosed: Your account has been closed. Thank you for using PatiPasaport.
